t: You're looking at the Shaftesbury Theatre, a West End playhouse on Shaftesbury Avenue, in Camden. It opened in 1911 as the New Prince's Theatre, with room for two and a half thousand people. Today it holds 1,416. The Shaftesbury name actually belonged to a different theatre further down the avenue until 1941, and this one took it on in 1963. The architect was Bertie Crewe, one of the leading English theatre designers during the building boom between 1885 and 1915. This is his work.
